translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yoni Tobafitaiso giꞋalika.
Tu medema tovai-nadi Helodi, fafali ana egana Galili adi tovehimeya, Yesu valeyana ginogalina.

Au yana kalivamomo gigahedi gigayo, “Bana kalivai-nadi valeyana kanogalina-ma au Yoni Tobafitaiso. GiꞋalika tu gimididi-havagi. Medema faꞋina abaveyaulowoga valeyana kanogalina-ma anafaiweya gififaisewana.”

Helodi hidedemi gigahe faꞋina boi yana kaliva givehimeyedi be Yoni hikiveꞋavina ada hiyogona be deliya hisena. Helodi tobohiyana Filifi vavinena adi egana Helodiyasi giluhabuyedi faꞋina, bana Yoni Helodi gidakeyena gigayo, “Badi kwamayoku-dina unagidi faꞋina nagi ana vehimeya keke udaꞋitaveꞋavini.” Hidedemi gigahe faꞋina Helodi Yoni deliya gisena.

Ada Helodi nuwanuwana Yoni ginaluveꞋalikana, tu yoꞋo yadi nuwakoyo gimatausena faꞋina badi Yoni hiveꞋamohimohinena higa vaita bana Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina. Hidedemi hinuwanuwa faꞋina Helodi giga-wayoga.

Himiyami tu Helodi yana tubuga ana toveya yana aꞋa lakahina gitagova be yana yoꞋo buye hiꞋa. Hivemwamwala tu Helodiyasi natudi kwamayoku yoꞋo matadiya givagavaga. Helodi gimatamatawabuwabu tu nuwana giyamumu-moꞋa faꞋina kwamayoku againe giwonadabadaba gigayo, “Yaubada matane gagahe velemoꞋena be gavadi gavadi faꞋina unaveꞋoꞋola, medema ganevele.”

Au ulaulatanina hinana Helodiyasi Yoni yana dakeya hiꞋagoꞋugena faꞋina natudi hihawaveleveleni-yo gigayo, “Udavehimeya be Yoni Tobafitaiso uꞋuna hinanikehegeni-yo nauꞋa againe hinaꞋaliyena be bana aliꞋalikana ganaꞋitana.”
Kini Helodi kwamayoku yana veꞋoꞋola ginogalini-yo nuwana gikabubu tu ana wakawaka moyaꞋaidi matadiya giwonadabadaba faꞋina, givehimeya be Yoni uꞋuna hinavelena.
Au yana kalivamomo gigahedi be hina deliya Yoni uꞋuna hinikehegena, nauꞋa againe hiꞋaliyena ulaulatanina hivelena ada au hinana agaidiya ginauwena.
Ma Yoni ana tomuliya hiꞋela Yoni wowona hivaini-yo hinauwena be hitauna. Hitauna gihavaina, hina Yesu hivenuwaꞋatana.
Yesu kaliva faifi tausani giveꞋadi.

Tu Yesu Yoni yana alika valeyana ginogalini-yo yoꞋo gihegedi tu gina wakeya giyage, tobuya gidamana be melalagaga saꞋeyana againe ginahobu anakaibe ginamiyami. Atu yoꞋo Yesu ahe gina ma hinogalina againe, yadi melala tulina tulina hihegedi be agediya Yesu himuliyena.
Bana Yesu wakeya ginauna tu gidamanaꞋela gihobu tu yoꞋo lakahidi giꞋita-yo gihinekalikaliyedi ada yadi toꞋaulolo gisiveyawadi.
Tu mala gilavina againe ana tomuliya Yesu againe hiꞋela higahe higayo, “Hida melalagaga againe kamimiyami ada mala gibogibogi. Au yoꞋo unaꞋatuhegedi be melala agaidiya hinana adiga hinakimonena.”
Bana Yesu gigayo, “Auwe hinamiya. Omi wanaveꞋadi.”
Badi higayo, “GavaiyaꞋamine ime anaveꞋadi? Beledi kabiꞋodi faifigaga kadu igana luhei ime agaimeya.”
Yesu gigayo, “WaꞋaliyeni weꞋai.”

Ada au yoꞋo givehimeyedi be isisiꞋu againe hinavetoga. Hivetoga-yo aꞋa faifi kadu igana luhei givaidi digo lobameya giꞋitalele Tamana againe givesiule, au aꞋa gikihinehineni-yo ana tomuliya giveledi ada badi yoꞋo agaidiya hifolakena.
Ada au moyaꞋaidi hiꞋa be hiꞋahiyauwa, ada tomuliya hina adi tufo kwadakwada hikwakwana feyawa tuwelo hivemagadi.
Badi kaliva aꞋai-nadi hiꞋa-ma adi kilagalaga au 5,000 tu vevine weꞋoweꞋo buyeꞋi a gavaiyehi.
Yesu niꞋu getane ginudadana.
Tu tomuliya kwadakwada hikwakwana gihavaina, Yesu gigahedi be wakeya hinayage wai hinanagona be yuwa fafaline hinamididamana tu Bana Tauna gimiya be yoꞋo ginaꞋatuhegedi.

Ada ahe giꞋatuhegedi-yo anakaibe oyeya gilaka be Tamana againe ginaveꞋoꞋola. Ada au mala gibogi-moꞋa tu anakaibe gimiyami tu badi tomuliya ma wakeya wese gawaneya hinauna, ada bolimana lakahina gimadu be giluluveyeveyewana faꞋina lefo waka giluluvilavilana.
Ada mala kabisona ginalauna tu Yesu badi agaidiya giꞋelaꞋela niꞋu getane ginunudadana.
Badi tomuliya niꞋu getane ginunudadana ma hiꞋita-yo himatautaveꞋine hitatawayana higayo, “Iyoi! Mene balauma.”
Atu auheꞋama Yesu gigahedi gigayo, “WaꞋasevatu. Hima Iya gaꞋelaꞋela, keke wanamatauta.”
Au Fita gigahe gigayo, “Kauveya, kaꞋi velemoꞋena OꞋeni, au ugahe be niꞋu getane O againiya ganaꞋela.”
Yesu gigayo, “UꞋela.” Gigahe-yo Fita wakeya gihobu niꞋu getane Yesu amine ginudadana.
Atu matana gidavelowona ma bolimana giꞋitana au yana matauta giyemu, ada givebutu gikamokamomola-yo gikova gigayo, “Kauveya unakibababaleku.”
Ada auheꞋama Yesu nimana gitunena digo gisilakahina be gigahena gigayo, “O ya vetumagana kabiꞋona ma gavana faꞋina aseꞋase giꞋamalakibo?”
Ada waka againe hiyemu-yo hiyage tu bolimana giꞋatagona.
Au tomuliya wakeya himiyami-ma Yesu hihawadavadavana higayo, “Wona velemoꞋena OꞋeni Yaubada Natuna.”
Yesu toꞋaulolo Genesaleda againe gisiveyawadi.
Tu tobuya hidamana-yo fafali ana egana Genesaleda againe hihobu.
Ada miGenesaleda Yesu hiꞋitayakahina againe, venuwaꞋata medema awaꞋawana melalina moyaꞋaina agaidiya hiꞋiveninisena be kaliva yadi toꞋaulolo Bana againe hiꞋaliyedi.
Au hihawayafeyafena be toꞋaulolo adifaiweya ana aikeva bwatanaga hinakibwaꞋena. Ada au gaveyao moyaꞋaidi hikibwaꞋena-ma hiyamumu.
